result.summary: The page is generally well-structured with no critical defects. The horizontally clipped restaurant card ("Trattoria Piccol...") and the partially visible card at the bottom of the viewport are intentional scroll indicators per the exclusions. One minor visual/content issue was identified in the "Fastest near you" carousel where a restaurant name is truncated with an ellipsis rather than by the screen edge.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccol...) has its name clipped mid-word by the right screen edge, showing 'Trattoria Piccol' without a clean ellipsis; while partial visibility of the last carousel item is expected, the title text is cut awkwardly at the card boundary making it hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to truncate with an ellipsis within the card bounds, or ensure text wraps/fades gracefully so partially visible carousel items remain legible.
